✨ 𝗞𝗘𝗬 𝗙𝗘𝗔𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗘𝗦 ✨

✅ Independent browser engine (not based on Gecko, WebKit, Blink)
✅ Targets practical HTML5, modern CSS, and JavaScript
✅ Primary platform: Linux, with macOS and Windows support
✅ Security features: Landlock sandbox, seccomp, no JIT
✅ Minimalist architecture: one page per window, one process
✅ Web standards compliance measured against specifications
✅ Supports audio (MP3, Opus, Vorbis), images (PNG, GIF, JPEG, WebP, AVIF), and SVG
✅ Features: Custom elements, Workers, IndexedDB, localStorage, Cache API, WebSockets, Service Workers, WebExtensions
✅ Networking: HTTP/2, HTTPS-first, HSTS, optional DoH, CSP, SRI
✅ Uses QuickJS for JavaScript and lexbor for HTML parsing

Northstar is a minimalist, independent web browser written in C, designed for Linux, macOS, and Windows. It aims for modern web standards compatibility without relying on existing browser engines like Gecko or WebKit, focusing on security and a lean architecture.

Web Shot is a Chrome extension that captures full-page scrolling screenshots of any webpage. It stitches together multiple frames into a single PNG, automatically saves it to the Downloads folder, and copies it to the clipboard for immediate use.
